verdict.rationale: Ramp's documentation directly supports budget allocation to teams/projects with card controls that enforce them: custom virtual cards with per-team/vendor spend permissions (ramp-docs-11, ramp-docs-31), pre-spend enforcement of limits and blocked merchants/categories (ramp-docs-9), policy-grounded recommended approve/reject actions (ramp-docs-10), and role/amount-based notification workflows (ramp-docs-12). This covers allocation, limit enforcement, and approvals working together. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of enforcement accuracy, and no explicit 'budget' object/API distinct from card limits shown in evidence.
